meta_description: VpnHood! – A free, secure, and open-source VPN with a global server network designed to protect your online privacy and ensure secure access to the web.
page_desc: Fast, secure, and reliable VPN solution powered by VpnHood! ENGINE, which is open-source and the first VPN developed fully with the .NET platform.
intro: VpnHood! CLIENT is the free, open-source app your users install — on Android, Android TV, Windows, and Linux. It is built so the person holding the key needs no explanation:
li_key_desc: Add an access key and you are connected — no account, no sign-up, nothing to configure.
li_fast_desc: Powered by VpnHood! ENGINE, with speed to spare for streaming and video calls.
li_protocol_desc: Holds a smooth, encrypted connection steady on networks that keep trying to drop it, over IPv4 and IPv6 alike.
li_cloak_desc: Dresses the tunnel as ordinary web traffic — a censor probing the connection gets a plain web-server reply instead of anything worth blocking.
li_proxy_desc: Blocked from connecting directly? Reach your server through a SOCKS or HTTP proxy, or relay through another network entirely.
li_split_desc: Choose what goes through the VPN — by app, IP address, domain, or country — so local apps like banking keep working untouched.
phones_alt: VpnHood! CLIENT on two phones: one connected and showing live download and upload speed, the other listing public and private access-key profiles
